package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for response_dto_uses_omitempty_on_required_contract_fields: Response shapes that silently drop fields that should be stable parts of the API contract.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type CustomerResponse struct {
	ID        int    `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Name      string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Email     string `json:"email,omitempty"`
	Status    string `json:"status,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt string `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
}

func GetCustomerHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	customer := CustomerResponse{
		ID:        0,
		Name:      "",
		Email:     "alice@example.com",
		Status:    "active",
		CreatedAt: "2025-03-01",
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(customer)
}

func ListCustomersHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	customers := []CustomerResponse{
		{ID: 1, Name: "Alice", Email: "", Status: "active", CreatedAt: "2025-03-01"},
		{ID: 0, Name: "", Email: "bob@example.com", Status: "inactive", CreatedAt: ""},
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(customers)
}
